info.name: Padosme Platform
info.description: Complete API collection for the Padosme platform microservices.

item.name: Auth Service (port 8080)
item.description: Authentication, device management, and admin user operations.

request.description: Send an OTP to the given mobile number for login or registration.
Verify the OTP and receive JWT access and refresh tokens.
Exchange a refresh token for a new JWT access token.
Service-to-service call to validate a WebSocket authentication token.
Invalidate the current session and refresh token.
Purchase a custom alternate user ID.
Retrieve the current user's alternate ID.
Delete the current user's alternate ID.
List all devices registered for the current user.
Remove a specific device from the user's registered devices.
Update the FCM push token for a specific device.
Admin endpoint to retrieve a user by their ID.
Admin endpoint to change a user's type (e.g. buyer, seller).
Admin endpoint to revoke all active sessions for a user.

item.name: User Profile Service (port 8081)
item.description: User profile CRUD, custom fields, and KYC verification.

request.description: Public endpoint to view a user profile by its ID.
Create a new user profile for the authenticated user.
Retrieve the authenticated user's profile.
Update fields on the authenticated user's profile.
Delete the authenticated user's profile.
Add a custom field to the user's profile.
List all custom fields on the authenticated user's profile.
Update the value of a specific custom profile field.
Remove a custom field from the user's profile.
Initiate Aadhar-based KYC verification. Sends an OTP to the linked mobile.
Complete Aadhar KYC by verifying the OTP received on the linked mobile.
Check the current KYC verification status for the authenticated user.

item.name: Seller Service (port 8082)
item.description: Seller onboarding, profiles, business cards, and admin moderation.

request.description: Public search for seller business cards.
Public endpoint to view a specific business card.
Upgrade a regular user account to a seller account.
Retrieve the seller profile for the authenticated user.
Update fields on the seller profile.
Update the GPS coordinates for the seller's business location.
Create a digital business card for the seller.
Retrieve the authenticated seller's business card.
Update the seller's business card details.
Delete the seller's business card.
Admin endpoint to mark a seller as verified.
Admin endpoint to suspend a seller account.
Admin endpoint to reactivate a suspended seller.
Admin endpoint to list all sellers on the platform.

item.name: Coupon Service (port 8083)
item.description: Sales campaigns, coupon issuance, validation, redemption, and salesman tracking.

request.description: Create a new sales campaign with discount rules and limits.
List all campaigns.
Get details of a specific campaign.
Update an existing campaign's details or limits.
Retrieve aggregate statistics for a campaign (redemptions, conversions, etc.).
View the activity log for a specific campaign.
Salesman scans seller QR and initiates coupon generation for a campaign.
Look up a coupon by its code to see status and details.
Service-to-service call to validate a coupon and get the discount details.
Service-to-service call to mark a coupon as redeemed after subscription purchase.
Get performance stats for a salesman (leads, conversions, coupons created/redeemed).

item.name: Wallet Service
item.description: Wallet creation, credits, debits, transfers, and transaction history.

request.description: Create a new wallet for a user or seller.
Get the current balance for a wallet by owner ID.
Add credits to a wallet.
Deduct credits from a wallet.
Transfer credits between two wallets.
List paginated transaction history for a wallet.

item.name: Subscription Service
item.description: Subscription wallet, packages, and admin package management.

request.description: Get the subscription wallet for a user.
Deduct credits from a user's subscription wallet.
Get transaction history for a user's subscription wallet.
List all available subscription packages.
Get details for a specific subscription package.
Admin endpoint to create a new subscription package.
Admin endpoint to update an existing subscription package.

item.name: Payment Service
item.description: Payment intents, confirmations, refunds, and provider webhooks.

request.description: Create a payment intent for a user purchase.
Confirm a payment after the provider has processed it.
List all payments for the authenticated user.
Get details of a specific payment.
Issue a full or partial refund for a payment. Set amount_in_inr to 0 for full refund.
Stripe webhook endpoint for payment event callbacks.
Razorpay webhook endpoint for payment event callbacks.

item.name: Analytics Service (port 8086)
item.description: Seller analytics, platform metrics, campaign analytics, and salesman performance.

request.description: Get an overview of analytics for a specific seller.
Admin endpoint for platform-wide analytics summary.
Admin endpoint for search-related analytics.
Admin endpoint for analytics of a specific campaign.
Get detailed metrics for a campaign within a date range.
Get the top performing campaigns.
Get performance metrics for a specific salesman.
Get the top performing salesmen.
Get platform-wide credit usage analytics.

item.name: Channel Service
item.description: Seller channels, posts, subscriptions, and content moderation.

request.description: Get the channel feed for a user based on their subscriptions.
Create a new post on a seller's channel.
Subscribe a user to a seller's channel.
Unsubscribe a user from a seller's channel.
Flag a post for moderation review.
Admin endpoint to list all flagged posts pending moderation.
Admin endpoint to take moderation action on a flagged post.

item.name: Search API (port 8090)
item.description: Proximity-based search and real-time WebSocket search.

request.description: Perform a proximity-based search for sellers and products.
WebSocket endpoint for real-time search results. Connect using a WebSocket client with the JWT token as a query parameter. Not testable directly in Postman — use a WebSocket client.

item.name: Config Service (port 8095)
item.description: Centralized configuration and feature flag management.

request.description: Retrieve a configuration value by key.
Retrieve all configuration values for a specific service.
Admin endpoint to create a new configuration entry.
Admin endpoint to update an existing configuration entry.
Admin endpoint to delete a configuration entry.
List all feature flags.
Get a specific feature flag by key.
Evaluate whether a feature flag is enabled for the current context.
Admin endpoint to create a new feature flag.
Admin endpoint to update a feature flag.
Admin endpoint to delete a feature flag.

item.name: Dictionary Service (port 8094)
item.description: Term expansion, synonym lookup, and admin approval workflows.

request.description: Expand a term into its synonyms and related terms.
Look up a term and find matching dictionary entries.
Admin endpoint to list terms pending approval.
Admin endpoint to list synonyms pending approval.
Approve pending dictionary terms.
Approve pending synonym entries.
Reject pending dictionary terms.
Reject pending synonym entries.

item.name: Notification Service
item.description: Device token management and dead-letter queue monitoring.

request.description: Register a device push token (FCM) for a user.
Remove a device push token for a user.
Admin endpoint to view the notification dead-letter queue.

Search for nearby sellers by geographic coordinates.

item.description: Search index management and dictionary approval.

request.description: Trigger a full rebuild of the search index.
Check the current status of the search index.
Trigger re-indexing for a specific seller.
List pending dictionary entries awaiting approval.
Approve a pending dictionary entry for inclusion in search.
List all available ledger actions.

Publish an event to the ledger event stream.

item.description: SMS sending and delivery status webhooks.

request.description: Send a test SMS to a phone number.
Twilio delivery status callback webhook.
